speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin; this is often called jaundice. To understand the severity and cause, how many hours old were you when this first started, and have you been feeding well?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (physiologic jaundice exacerbated by inadequate intake). The weight gain is appropriate, but I need to confirm hydration status and rule out hemolysis. REQUEST TEST: Bilirubin_level (total and direct), Blood_type_and_Coombs_test, Complete_blood_count.
